members.name: create_prompt
members.doc:
Create a prompt.

Parameters
----------
context : Context | Sequence[Context]
    Context or list of contexts. Each context is a sequence of entries
    where each entry is a raw sequence (``bytes``/``str``, optionally with
    ``:`` chain breaks for multichain), [`Protein`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Protein), or
    [`Complex`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Complex). Currently only protein chains are accepted;
    passing a Complex with DNA, RNA, or Ligand chains raises
    `InvalidParameterError`. This restriction may be relaxed
    in the future.
name : str
    Name of the prompt.
description : Optional[str]
    Description of the prompt.

Returns
-------
Prompt
    The created prompt.

parsed.text: Create a prompt.

members.name: create_query
members.doc:
Create a query.

Parameters
----------
query : bytes or str or Protein or Complex
    A query protein or complex. Raw ``bytes``/``str`` inputs may include
    ``:`` chain breaks to denote a multichain protein. Currently only
    protein chains are accepted; passing a Complex with DNA, RNA, or
    Ligand chains raises `InvalidParameterError`. This
    restriction may be relaxed in the future.
force_structure : bool, optional
    Optionally force a query to be interpreted with a structure.
    Useful for creating structure prediction queries which can have
    no structure.

Returns
-------
Query
    The created query.

parsed.text: Create a query.

members.name: get_as_complexes
members.doc:
Retrieve the prompt context with every entry as a [`Complex`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Complex).

Single-chain entries are wrapped as ``Complex({"A": protein})`` so the
return type is uniform regardless of chain count.

members.name: wait
members.doc:
Wait for the job to complete, then fetch results.

Parameters
----------
interval : int, optional
    Time in seconds between polling. Defaults to `config.POLLING_INTERVAL`.
timeout : int | None, optional
    Maximum time in seconds to wait. Defaults to None.
verbose : bool, optional
    Verbosity flag. Defaults to False.

Returns
-------
Any
    The results of the job.

entries.name: Query
entries.doc:
Query containing a sequence/structure used to query the design models which opens up new workflows.

Create a query with a masked sequence using [`mask_sequence_at`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Protein.mask_sequence_at) for [`PoET2Model`](/python-api/api-reference/embedding#openprotein.embeddings.PoET2Model) to run inverse folding.

Create a query with a masked structure using [`mask_structure_at`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Protein.mask_structure_at) for [`RFdiffusionModel`](/python-api/api-reference/models#openprotein.models.RFdiffusionModel) to run inverse folding.

members.name: get
members.doc:
Retrieve the query as a [`Protein`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Protein) or  [`Complex`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Complex).

Single-chain queries collapse to [`Protein`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Protein); multichain queries are
returned as [`Complex`](/python-api/api-reference/molecules#openprotein.molecules.Complex). For a uniform return type, see
[`get_as_complex`](/python-api/api-reference/prompt#openprotein.prompt.Query.get_as_complex) or [`get_as_protein`](/python-api/api-reference/prompt#openprotein.prompt.Query.get_as_protein).

Returns:
    Protein or Complex representing the query
